external_entities.name: Supplier

external_entities.description: A category manager who reviews, approves, or rejects supplier documents.

processes.description: A vendor-hosted portal receiving supplier documents and category-manager decisions, and producing a nightly supplier data extract.

processes.description: A service that loads a file into the landing bucket and writes supplier records to the supplier database.
